meta.title: Elements Luxury Living — Luxury Is Subjective

source.ref: Elements Luxury Living - AI Real Estate Film | Can of Tales
source.premise_input: Reference film from URL: Elements Luxury Living - AI Real Estate Film | Can of Tales

narrative.logline: A luxury developer argues that luxury is personal by touring a dozen impossible dream-spaces — each one someone's private definition — before handing the definition to you.
narrative.theme: Luxury is subjective — it is whatever the individual decides it is.
narrative.narrative_pov: second-person address — the VO speaks directly to 'you'
narrative.structure_model: anaphora montage — a chain of 'it's…' vignettes escalating to a brand reveal

beats.name: The question
beats.synopsis: 'Luxury?' holds in gold over a grand living room — the thesis is posed.

beats.name: It's subjective
beats.synopsis: Greenhouse bedroom, chinoiserie room, terracotta corridor and a teapot bathroom flash by — luxury refuses one look.

beats.name: The moon flex
beats.synopsis: A man lounges on the moon — 'no suit, no shuttle, just custom flooring.'

beats.name: Play & romance
beats.synopsis: A youth glides on a hoverboard by an infinity pool, then a couple waltzes in an empty ballroom.

beats.name: Style, silence, water
beats.synopsis: A yellow-suited man with a bow-tied dog, a hushed library, an empty calm pool.

beats.name: Queen, groove, outfits
beats.synopsis: A Moroccan spa, a dancer in a surreal pop room, a woman in a walk-in closet — the brightest run.

beats.name: The owners
beats.synopsis: Mr. Shinoy takes high tea in an elevator; Mrs.' luxury purrs — a live cheetah.

beats.name: For you to define
beats.synopsis: Fade to black; the ELEMENTS 'Luxury Living' logo resolves in white.

hook.promise: we will redefine what luxury means — and it will surprise you
hook.first_frame_visual: a grand double-height living room with a floating white staircase, the word LUXURY? in gold serif across it

payoff.description: the ELEMENTS 'Luxury Living' logo resolves out of black with the line 'for you to define' — the anaphora is handed back to the viewer.

loop.seam_note: ends on a brand end-card, not built to loop back to the open.

world.setting: A suite of imaginary high-end interiors — each a self-contained fantasy of luxury living, in a real-estate / architectural-showcase register.
world.scale_logic: Each vignette is a complete world of its own; there is no shared geography. The through-line is tone and the recurring gold accent, not place.
world_rules: every space is aspirational, impossibly clean and fully styled
reality bends for the fantasy — a moon-floor lounge, a giant teapot shower, a pet cheetah indoors
one 'owner' character inhabits each hero space
the brand's argument (luxury = personal) overrides physical logic

yellow bow tie: fastened by a mustard-sleeved hand on the dog (kf37-39) → worn by the seated dog beside the yellow-suit man (kf40-43)
elevator floor panel: no button lit (kf79) → the '3' lights up (kf80); same walnut car as the tea gentleman (kf76-83)
brand end-card build: solid black (kf91-92) → 'ELEMENTS' alone (kf93) → wordmark + building mark + 'LUXURY LIVING' tagline fully formed (kf95-100)

cinematography.camera_analog: clean digital-cinema look styled as a high-end real-estate / commercial reel; AI-generated, so no true lens — the feel is anamorphic-flavoured widescreen
cinematography.format_texture: crisp and glossy; high-key in the daylight spaces, moody chiaroscuro in the ballroom and elevator; minimal grain
lens_set: one low ultra-wide for the pop room
cinematography.depth_of_field: mostly deep for the interiors so the whole space reads; shallow on the detail inserts (shoes, hands, bow tie, teacup)
movement_vocab: locked wide with the subject moving inside it
cinematography.angle_bias: eye-level to slightly low; strong central symmetry favoured; one dramatic low ultra-wide for the pop-room dance
composition_rules: let the architecture frame the subject (arches, columns, doorways, the lift box)
leave negative space early for the on-screen serif word
make the subject small inside a large, richly-dressed volume

forbidden: flat lifeless grey as a dominant field (reserved only for the black end-card reset)

pattern.device: anaphora — most lines begin 'It's…' (8 of ~17: 5 bare, 3 carried in on perhaps / or / maybe)
pattern.line_shape: a short fragment, ~6 words, each delivering one surprising definition of luxury

pattern.how_it_lands: names two specific owners, then hands the definition to the audience — 'for you to define'
pattern.borrow_this: keep the 'it's…' anchor on ~8 of ~17 lines — the repetition IS the structure; do not vary it away

script: No suit, no shuttle, just custom flooring.
It's overboarding because walking is so par.
Perhaps it's dancing in a ballroom meant for two.
Or it's the kind of style that makes walls blush.
A conversation between privacy and silence.
It's a pool with no screaming children.
Maybe it's living like a queen or a room that matches your groove.
It's an outfit for every mood.
For Mr. Shinoy, it's Heidi in an elevator.
